_source: the project template's command defaults read from the drawing (cs/01_style_inventory.cs, qa/style_inventory.json): CreateProfileView -> 'ARJV_ Land Desktop Profile View' + band set 'ARJV_Band set' (dam set: EG, crest, excavation, horizontal data, 20/10 m); CreateMultipleProfileView (the long-alignment command) -> same view style + 'HTJ (EG-FG Elevations and Stations)' (100/25 m); CreateAlignment -> 'ARJV_ (Alignment)' + 'ARJV_Alignment Label Set'; CreateProfileFromSurface -> 'ARJV_ Rock Excavation Profile' + '_No Labels' (the EG style 'ARJV_ Existing Ground Level' is used for existing ground instead)

gdp._note: the ground design profile 'GDP <name>' (25_gdp.py): the template's design profile style, as in the engineer's sample 'SAK-CH3-SM GDP'; breaks marked on layer W5-GDP-BREAKS
